text:
Type: adjustable nickel work lamp
Use: task light for reading and working at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: industrial, retro, classic
Materials: nickel-plated steel shade, arm and base, knurled metal joints
Colors: silver nickel, black cord
Shape: bell shade on a jointed arm with ball-end pivots and a counterbalance rod, straight stem on a stepped round base, mechanical look, medium visual weight
Feel: crafted, vintage, sturdy, studious
Goes with: dark wood desks, leather, black or grey walls, metal accents; industrial or classic home offices

product.name: BAROMETER
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable.
